profiles.evidenceBoundary: This profile defines both corrected finite-stop and positive-infinity/capture-bounded cases a future R049 receipt must execute. Revision 5 supersedes historical revision 3 rather than transferring its evidence. Structural or semantic acceptance does not authenticate NEST, the declared build, the infinity projection, process topology, status custody, buffer/configuration/wiring history, capture timing, or sender-universe truth. A positive-infinity upper endpoint is the declared capture, not device deactivation, and establishes nothing after capture. R049 remains NOT_RUN until a durable receipt binds the exact v5 profile, source commit, runtime wheel, build profile, toolchain, harness bytes, and results.
